_meta.purpose: Source of truth for backend/config/airportCities.json. Hand-maintained allow-list of real, currently-bookable destinations from Ben Gurion Airport (TLV), NOT derived from the frozen-since-2014 OpenFlights routes.dat (see build-tlv-destinations.js for why that was rejected as the sole gate — it hid ~80 real current routes including Dubai, Lisbon and Tokyo while keeping dead ones).
_meta.method: El Al's own live city-to-city sitemap (elal.com/flight-deals/en-il/sitemap/city-to-city-flights, 81 cities, current bookable TLV routes as crawled) cross-checked against Wikipedia's List of El Al destinations and 2026 news coverage (AirlineGeeks, Times of Israel, JPost) for route status, plus Wizz Air's Sept 2026 TLV expansion (Times of Israel) for 3 non-El-Al additions (Cluj-Napoca, Vilnius, Bratislava). Every city name verified resolvable against WeatherAPI.com's geocoding search endpoint (the provider backend/services/weatherService.js actually calls) so every listed destination is guaranteed to have a weather source, not just a label that looks like a place.
_meta.excluded: Moscow and Kyiv deliberately excluded despite appearing on some route lists: El Al suspended Russia service (confirmed June 2026, suspended until at least March 2027) and Ukraine routes have been suspended since Feb 2022. Both are stale sitemap remnants, not real bookable options.
_meta.renamedFromSource: A few El Al labels were cleaned to a plain, geocodable city name: 'Fort Lauderdale, Miami Area' -> Fort Lauderdale; 'Heraklion (Crete)' -> Heraklion; 'Hong Kong (China)' -> Hong Kong; 'Patras-Peloponnese' -> Patras; 'Sardinia' (region) -> Cagliari (the actual airport city); 'Sicily' (region) -> Catania (the actual airport city); 'Sitia (Crete)' -> Sitia.
_meta.maintenance: Re-review periodically (airline route networks change every season). This file is the thing to edit; then run node backend/scripts/build-tlv-destinations.js to regenerate config/airportCities.json.
